notes.title: Monthly change report Nr. 2
notes.content:
Monthly change report Nr 1. 
(for minor updates see  discussion)

V 0.2.0.0
-There are now leaderboards for the first 4 levels for every power level. You will see global best time and your best time. You can tweak other settings to get the best time for level+power selection.

-There is now a ghost driver, which replays your best round time. The ghost driver starts around a secound later, so you dont have to overturn him to get a better time. You only need to catch up. You also cant collide with your ghost. When you start a track you maybe have to drive 2 rounds before you see him.

-Ghost driver can be switch off if you dont like him.

-From now on you must be loged in in Steam to play the game and steam must be running in the background.

V 0.1.1.0
worked on race car
Added motion blur. Can be disabled in options.
Changed coloring.

V 0.1.0.1
Added head moving when steering, so you can see more ahead when you driving in hard corners. The effect can be disabled under 'Visual' settings in config in case you dont like it.
